recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast vector illustration featuring four male portraits arranged in a central cluster, surrounded by urban lifestyle icons like motorcycles, SUVs, and silhouettes, all set against a deep red gradient background with bold, blocky isometric lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Centralized character cluster as the primary focal point
Symmetrical framing using lifestyle silhouettes and floral motifs
Dynamic upward-angled typography creating a sense of scale
High-contrast cel-shading for skin tones and metallic surfaces
coreInvariants: Heavy black outlines on all vector elements
Limited color palette of red, orange, yellow, and black
Sharp, geometric highlights on sunglasses and jewelry

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four large-scale portraits occupy the center 60% of the canvas in a diamond formation.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bottom-center portrait, which is the largest and most detailed.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central faces, moves upward to the large title, then circles down through the side icons (bike/car) to the floral base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep red gradient corners provide breathing room for the complex central collage.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red to dark maroon gradient for the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow and orange for highlights, silhouettes, and typography faces.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for specular highlights on eyes, jewelry, and chrome.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm spectrum against flat black shadows creates a 'glowing' effect.
paletteRestrictions: No cool colors (blues/greens) except for subtle metallic reflections

letterConstructionRules: Isometric 3D extrusion pointing downwards and to the right
Uniform stroke width with sharp 90-degree corners
Top faces feature a vertical orange-to-yellow gradient
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are truncated to fit a tight rectangular block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant custom face supported by iconographic silhouettes.
graphicDevices: Symmetrical floral/rose borders at the base

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky structure for modification.
The interlocking 3D effect is best achieved through manual vector paths.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vector collage on a dark red gradient. Center four cel-shaded male portraits in sunglasses and hats. Flank them with a red motorcycle on the left and a red SUV on the right. Add a base of red roses and yellow female silhouettes. Use thick black outlines for all elements.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, blocky, isometric 3D text at the top. The text should have a yellow-to-orange gradient on the front face and a thick black 3D extrusion dropping down. Tilt the text slightly upward.

verificationChecks: Are all elements outlined in thick black?
Is the 3D extrusion of the text consistent in direction?
Do the portraits use high-contrast cel-shading?
Is the color palette restricted to red, orange, yellow, and black?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness issues
Any brand logos on hats or vehicles
Unique decorative flourishes in the background
recipe.reuseFormula: Vector-style urban collage + central character cluster + isometric block typography + warm-tone limited palette + thick black keylines.
